## Manual curation analysis combining checkm, eggnog, gtdbtk, memote, gem predicted auxos, and lab defined auxos


```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Packages used throughout this notebook. The tidyverse is loaded last so that dplyr's
# select()/filter() take precedence. Specialised plotting packages (ggalluvial, gggenes,
# gggenomes) are loaded where they are first used, further below.
library(caret)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(factoextra)
library(tidyverse)

# Load the shared data objects (reads the committed data under data/ and builds the objects
# used across the analysis notebooks: checkm, metadata, auxolab, auxo2, kemet, kemet_auxo_all,
# eggnog, isfinder_count, genes_count, etc.). Run all notebooks from the repository root.
source("analysis/00_load_data.R")
```

```{r}
# get FN determined by GEMs but look into the KEGG biosynthesis modules for the 14/20 AAs with dedicated KEGG module
full_join(kemet_auxo_all %>%drop_na() %>% filter(agree==0,auxo_kemet==1) %>% group_by(name) %>% summarise(count=n()),kemet_auxo_all %>%drop_na() %>% filter(agree==0,auxo_kemet==0) %>% group_by(name) %>% summarise(count=n()),by="name") %>% rename(no_genomic=count.x,yes_genomic=count.y) %>% mutate(yes_genomic = replace_na(yes_genomic, 0),no_genomic = replace_na(no_genomic, 0)) %>% group_by(name) %>% mutate(total_fp = sum(no_genomic,yes_genomic),percent=100*yes_genomic/total_fp) %>% full_join(.,auxo2 %>% group_by(name) %>% summarize(count=n())) %>% select(-count) %>% relocate(name,total_fp,percent,yes_genomic,no_genomic) %>% left_join(.,auxo2 %>% filter(auxo_lab==1,auxo_model==0) %>% group_by(name) %>% summarize(count=n())) %>% View()
```

```{r}
library(caret)
# lets have some cleaned up code for the evaluation of GEMs and genomes against lab predictions

# load bigg mets
bigg_mets = read.delim("data/figure_data/bigg_classes.tsv")
# load metadata
metadata = read.delim("data/figure_data/soil_auxo_metadata_full.tsv")
# define exclude ions
ions = c("zn2","so4","k","pi","o2","mn2","mg2","ca2","cl","h","cobalt2","cu2","fe2")

### Load auxotrophy data from ghada's lab experiments, add column for merging with CarveMe/BiGG metabolites
auxolab = read.delim("data/figure_data/auxolab_summary.tsv") %>% 
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% 
  select(c(Sample_ID,AAs_auxo:Nucleotide_auxo,Ala:Val)) %>%
  pivot_longer(!Sample_ID,values_to = "auxo_lab", names_to = "metabolite") %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Ala","L-Alanine",metabolite)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Arg","L-Arginine",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Asp","L-Aspartic acid",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Asn","L-Asparagine",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Cys","L-Cysteine",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Glu","L-Glutamate",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Gln","L-Glutamine",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Gly","Glycine",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("His","L-Histidine",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Ile","L-Isoleucine",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Leu","L-Leucine",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Lys","L-Lysine",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Met","L-Methionine",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Phe","L-Phenylalanine",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Pro","L-Proline",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Ser","L-Serine",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Thr","L-Threonine",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Trp","L-Tryptophan",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Tyr","L-Tyrosine",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Val","L-Valine",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("AAs_auxo","*aminoacids",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Vitamin_auxo","*vitamins",name)) %>%
  mutate(name=gsub("Nucleotide_auxo","*nucleotides",name)) %>%
  mutate(auxo_lab=as.factor(auxo_lab))

# Load auxotophy prediction based on reframed + MMAB informed gapfilled gems, add cols for amino acids that were not auxo predicted
# note that auxopred below corresponds to the naive model predictions, and the other auxopred3,4,5 correspond to tweaking auxo call 
# paramters but didnt find anything usefult here
auxopred2 = read.delim("data/figure_data/auxopred_default.tsv") %>% 
    mutate(present=1) %>% filter(metabolite!="") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "metabolite",values_from = "present",values_fill = 0) %>% 
    mutate(ala__L=0,arg__L=0,asp__L=0,cys__L=0,glu__L=0,gly=0,leu__L=0,met__L=0,pro__L=0,ser__L=0,tyr__L=0) %>% 
    pivot_longer(!model,values_to = "auxo_model",names_to = "compound") %>% 
    rename(genome=model) %>%
    left_join(.,bigg_mets %>% select(name,compound),by="compound") %>%
    mutate(Sample_ID = gsub("_.*$","",genome), auxo_model = as.factor(auxo_model)) %>%
    mutate(name=gsub("L-Glutamic acid","L-Glutamate",name)) %>% filter(!compound %in% ions)

# join model prediction and lab observations
auxo2 = left_join(auxolab,auxopred2 %>% filter(!compound%in%ions) ,by=c("name","Sample_ID")) %>% 
    drop_na() %>%
    mutate(agree=as.numeric(ifelse(auxo_lab==auxo_model,"1","0")))


#### CHRISTIAN PLOT SUGGESTIOn

# scatter with GEMs vs observations
ggscatter(auxo2 %>% mutate(auxo_lab=as.integer(auxo_lab)-1,auxo_model=as.integer(auxo_model)-1) %>% 
              ungroup() %>% group_by(genome) %>% summarise(auxo_lab_sum=sum(auxo_lab),auxo_model_sum=sum(auxo_model)),x="auxo_lab_sum",y="auxo_model_sum",add="reg.line",conf.int = FALSE) + stat_cor(method="pearson") + xlab("Total observed auxotrophies") + ylab("Total predicted auxotrophies") + theme_bw() -> scatter_1

              ungroup() %>% group_by(genome) %>% summarise(auxo_lab_sum=sum(auxo_lab),auxo_model_sum=sum(auxo_model)) %>%
                select(genome,auxo_lab_sum)),x="auxo_lab_sum",y="auxo_kemet_sum",add="reg.line",conf.int = FALSE) + stat_cor(method="pearson") + xlab("Total observed auxotrophies") + ylab("Total predicted auxotrophies") + theme_bw() -> scatter_2

ggsave("outputs/scatter_annotations_GEMs.png",height = 4,width = 8)
```

```{r}

### Load libs
library(tidyverse)

### Set wd
# setwd("~/Documents/soil_auxo/manual_curation/")  # repointed: run from repo root

### Load supp data files
bigg_mets = read.delim("data/figure_data/bigg_classes.tsv")
metadata = read.delim("data/figure_data/soil_auxo_metadata_full.tsv")

#load contigs and bp
contigs_bp = read.delim("data/figure_data/genome_contigs_bp.tsv")

### Load checkm data with completeness and contam
checkm = read.delim("data/figure_data/checkm_summary.tsv") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(genome=Bin.Id) %>%
  mutate(Quality=ifelse(Completeness>=90&Contamination<=5,"HQ","MQ")) %>%
  mutate(Sample_ID=gsub("_.*$","",genome)) %>%
  left_join(.,metadata,by="Sample_ID") %>% left_join(.,contigs_bp,by="genome")

# Plot, as expected isolates are mostly HQ, MAGs mostly MQ
ggplot(checkm,aes(x=Completeness,y=Contamination,color=Quality,shape=Type)) + 
  geom_point()

# check size and contigs
ggplot(checkm,aes(x=size,y=contigs,color=Quality,shape=Type)) + 
    geom_point() + scale_y_log10() + scale_x_log10()

#########


binplot = ggplot(checkm, aes(x=Sample_ID,fill= Quality)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "count",color="black") +
    ylab("Assembled genomes") + 
    xlab("Sample") +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
    coord_flip() + theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) + facet_grid(Type~.,scales = "free_y",space = "free") + scale_fill_manual(values=c("#66c2a5","#8da0cb"))

compcont = ggplot(checkm) + 
  geom_point(aes(Completeness,Contamination,color=Quality,shape=Type,size=4)) + theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + scale_color_manual(values=c("#66c2a5","#8da0cb"))


contigsSize = ggplot(checkm) + 
    geom_point(aes(contigs,size,color=Quality,shape=Type,size=4)) + scale_y_log10() + scale_x_log10() +
    ylab("Size (bp)") + 
    xlab("Contigs") + theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") + guides(shape=guide_legend(nrow=4,title.position="top",title.hjust = 0.5),color=guide_legend(nrow=4,title.position="top",title.hjust = 0.5)) + scale_color_manual(values=c("#66c2a5","#8da0cb")) + 
  scale_size_continuous(guide="none")


#plot=grid.arrange(binplot,grid.arrange(compcont,contigsSize,nrow=2,ncol=1,heights=c(1,1.1)),nrow=1,widths=c(1,1)
#ggsave("outputs/binningVis.pdf",plot=plot,height = 14.6,width = 10.4)
#ggsave("outputs/binningVis.png",plot=plot,height = 14.6,width = 10.4)

ggarrange(binplot+ theme(text=element_text(size=20)),ggarrange(compcont+ theme(text=element_text(size=20)),contigsSize+ theme(text=element_text(size=20)),nrow = 2,heights = c(1,1.25),labels = c("b","c"),font.label = list(size=25)),labels=c("a"),nrow=1,widths = c(1.4,1),font.label = list(size=25))
ggsave("outputs/binningVis.pdf",height = 14.6,width = 10.4)
ggsave("outputs/binningVis.png",height = 14.6,width = 10.4)

write_delim(checkm,"outputs/binningVis_data.tsv",delim = "\t")

### Load gtdbtk data with taxonomic assignments of genomes
gtdbtk = read.delim("data/figure_data/gtdbtk_summary.tsv") %>% 
  rename(genome=user_genome) %>% 
  separate(.,classification,sep = ";",c("Domain","Phylum","Class","Order","Family","Genus","Species")) %>%
  left_join(.,checkm,by="genome")

# Plot quality with taxonomy, looks like there is more taxonomic diveristy in the metagenomic samples as expected
ggplot(gtdbtk,aes(x=Completeness,y=Contamination,shape=Quality,color=Phylum)) + 
  geom_point()

### Load eggnogg gene annotations
eggnog = read.delim("data/annotations/eggnog_summary.tsv.gz") %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^A$","rna processing and modification",COG_category)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^B$","chromatin structure and dynamics",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^C$","energy production and conversion",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^D$","cell cycle control and mitosis",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^E$","amino acid metabolism and transport",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^F$","nucleotide metabolism and transport",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^G$","carbohydrate metabolism and transport",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^H$","coenzyme metabolism",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^I$","lipid metabolism",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^J$","tranlsation",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^K$","transcription",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^L$","replication and repair",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^M$","cell wall/membrane/envelop biogenesis",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^N$","cell motility",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^O$","post-translational modification, protein turnover, chaperone functions",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^P$","inorganic ion transport and metabolism",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^Q$","secondary structure",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^T$","signal transduction",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^U$","intracellular trafficing and secretion",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^V$","defense mechanism",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^Y$","nuclear structure",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^Z$","cytoskeleton",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^R$","general functional prediction only",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("^S$","function unknown ",cog_name)) %>%
  mutate(cog_name=gsub("-","function unknown ",cog_name)) %>%
  left_join(.,gtdbtk,by="genome")

#all PCA PLOT
eggnog %>% group_by(genome,Preferred_name) %>% summarise(count=n()) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = "Preferred_name",values_from = "count",values_fill = 0) %>% pivot_longer(!genome,names_to = "Preferred_name",values_to = "count") %>% left_join(.,checkm) %>% drop_na() %>% ungroup() -> egg_sum
# Benjamini-Hochberg correction is applied GLOBALLY across all genes (adjust the raw
# per-gene p-values with p.adjust). This reproduces the 260-gene set independently of the
# ggpubr version: newer ggpubr applies group.by= adjustment per group (i.e. no correction
# for these single-comparison groups), which would leave the p-values unadjusted.
compare_means(count ~ AAs_auxo ,egg_sum,method="wilcox.test",group.by = "Preferred_name") %>% mutate(p.adj=p.adjust(p,method="BH")) %>% filter(p.adj<=0.05) -> egg_sum_comp

# 77% agreement/accuracy doesnt seem so bad, however lets have a look at the confusion matrix ... 

#true positives and true negatives
auxo %>% group_by(auxo_model) %>% summarize(count=sum(agree))
#false positives and false negatives
auxo %>% filter(agree==0) %>% group_by(auxo_model) %>% summarise(count=n())

## CONFUSION MATRIX
#
#     P   N
# T  17  747
# F  53  175

TN = 747 # model correctly thinks that species is proto
FP = 53 # model incorrectly thinks that species is auxo, while the lab said it was proto
# with 800 total protos detected in the lab, the models are able to pick up 747
# representing 93.375% specificity, meaning that its pretty good at detecting prototrophs

FN = 175 # model incorrectly thinks that species is proto, while the lab said it was auxo
TP = 17 # model correctly thinks that species is auxo
# with 192 total auxos detected in the lab, the models were only able to pick up 17
# representing only 8.85% recall, meaning that you are better off flipping a coin than 
# relying on the models :(

# precision = TP / TP + FP, considers false positives
prec = TP/(TP+FP)
prec

# recall = TP / TP + FN, considers false negatives
rec = TP/(TP+FN)
rec

# f1 score = 2(precision*recall)/(precision+ recall)
f1 = (2*TP) / (2*TP + FP + FN)
```

```{r}
ggsave("outputs/gapfillled_BCAA.png",height = 8,width=14)

#overall, not looking just at BCAA
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
# Exploratory gene-synteny visualisation (not a published figure); reads a non-committed
# WiDb.csv, so it is shown but not evaluated.
library(gggenomes)

# here we carry out a visualization analysis inspired by https://github.com/thackl/gggenomes/blob/master/data-raw/emales.org
# idea is to plot our genomes and show BCAA genes across assemblies and show which are auxo and which are proto, hopefully
# revealing some inserted element responsible for BCAA auxo

# subsample using isolates to test
metadata %>% filter(grepl("isolate",Type,ignore.case = TRUE)) %>% select(Sample_ID) ->sub_samples

#1. read in sequences (genome information) 
# taken from drep output, has genome id and length

#test
#seqs = read_fai("lane122s000517_bin.2.s.fa.fna")
#seqs2 = read_seq_len("lane122s000517_bin.2.s.fa.fna")

genome_info=read_csv("WiDb.csv")

seqs = genome_info %>% select(genome,size) %>% rename(seq_id=genome,length=size) %>% mutate(seq_id=gsub("\\.fa","",seq_id)) %>% arrange(length) %>% mutate(Sample_ID=gsub("_.*$","",seq_id))

seqs_sub = seqs %>% filter(seq_id=="lane122s000599_bin.1.p") %>% mutate(length="29529")

gggenomes(seqs=seqs_sub) +
    geom_seq() + geom_bin_label()

#2. read in gene annotations
# generated from prodigal output where each genome was trained against itself in normal mode
# terminal: 
# $ while read file;do prodigal -f gff -i $file -o prodigal_gff/$(basename ${file%.*}.gff);done< <(ls dna/*|grep fa)
# $ while read file;do cat $file|grep -v '#'|sed "s/^/$(basename ${file%.*})_/g";done< <(ls prodigal_gff/*.gff) > soil_mags.gff


# this read_gff3 function seems to filter out many gene hits? try reading in manually
#genes=read_gff3("data/annotations/soil_mags.gff.gz")
#genes_readgff3 = genes

# read in file
genes = read.delim("data/annotations/soil_mags.gff.gz",header=FALSE)
# add colnames
colnames(genes) = c("contig","source","type","start","end","score.1","strand","zero","details")
# split details into individul cols and name them, from https://github.com/hyattpd/prodigal/wiki/understanding-the-prodigal-output#gene-coordinates altho some were missing
genes <- genes %>% separate(.,details,into = c("ID","partial","start_type","rbs_motif","rbs_spacer","gc_cont","conf","score","cscore","sscore","rscore","uscore","tscore","mscore"),sep = ";")
# create seq_id for genome ID and feat_id for protein ID
genes <- genes %>% mutate(seq_id=gsub("^([^_]+_[^_]+).*", "\\1",contig),feat_id=gsub("^.*_","",ID),contig2=contig) %>% unite("feat_id",c(contig2,feat_id))

genes_sub <- genes %>% filter(contig=="lane122s000599_bin.1.p_NODE_1_length_29529_cov_2.542136")

#test
# genes = read.delim("outputs/lane122s000517_bin.2.genes.tsv",header=FALSE) %>% rename(seq_id=V1,start=V2,end=V3,strand=V4) %>% mutate(length=end-start)

gggenomes(seqs=seqs_sub,genes=genes_sub) +
    geom_seq() + geom_bin_label() +
  geom_gene(aes(fill=strand), position="strand") 

 ggsave("outputs/test.pdf",height=20,width=20)

# works with toy data
gggenomes(emale_genes, emale_seqs_proper) +
    geom_seq() + geom_bin_label() +
    geom_gene(aes(fill=strand), position="strand") 

```

Alanine, aspartate, glutamate, glutamine, asparagine: 
* "ko00250" or "M00250"
* short pathways, redundant, close to central carbon, nitrogen assimilation

Serine, Threonine, Glycine : "ko00260" or "M00020|M00018|M00033"

Cysteine, Methionine: "ko00270" or "M00021|M00338|M00609|M00017"

Valine, Leucine, Isoleucine: "ko00280|ko00290" or "M00019|M00535|M00570|M00432"

Lysine: "ko00300|ko00310" or "M00016|M00525|M00526|M00527|M00030|M00433|M00031"

Arginine, Proline: "ko00220|ko00330" or "M00028|M00763|M00844|M00845|M00029|M00015"

Histidine: "ko00340" or "M00026"

Tryptophan, Phenylalanine, Tyrosine: "ko00350|ko00360|ko00380|ko00400" or "M00022|M00023|M00024|M00910|M00025|M00040"

Very interesting exploration above, do the same for the other problematic genome also to get an idea

Below we take a histidine-centric view to compare the pathway strucutre and relationship with auxotrophy discrepancies.
This and the trp operon are good examples to look at since they are some of the pathways known to be organized into operons!

```{r}
AA_KEGG_modules_ID = c("M00020","M00018","M00021","M00338","M00609","M00017","M00019","M00535","M00570","M00432","M00016","M00525","M00526","M00527","M00030","M00433","M00031","M00844","M00845","M00015","M00026","M00022","M00023","M00024","M00910","M00025","M00040")
AA_KEGG_modules_meta = c("ser/thr","ser/thr","cys/met","cys/met","cys/met","cys/met","BCAA","BCAA","BCAA","BCAA","lysine","lysine","lysine","lysine","lysine","lysine","lysine","arg/pro","arg/pro","arg/pro","his","aromatic","aromatic","aromatic","aromatic","aromatic","aromatic")
AA_KEGG_modules = data.frame(AA_KEGG_modules_ID,AA_KEGG_modules_meta) %>% rename(KEGG_Module=AA_KEGG_modules_ID)

kemet = read.delim("data/figure_data/kemet_summary.tsv",header = FALSE) %>% select(-V8) %>% 
    rename(genome=V1,KEGG_Module=V2,module_name=V3,completeness=V4,nPresent__nTotal=V5,missing_KEGG_ko=V6,present_KEGG_ko=V7) %>%
    separate(.,nPresent__nTotal,into=c("n_present","n_total"),sep="__") %>% 
    mutate(n_present=as.numeric(n_present),n_total=as.numeric(n_total),n_missing=n_total-n_present) %>% 
    left_join(.,checkm,by="genome")

ggplot(kemet %>% filter(Sample_ID=="lane122s000516") %>% 
         filter(KEGG_Module %in% AA_KEGG_modules$KEGG_Module) %>% 
         mutate(completeness = fct_relevel(completeness,"COMPLETE","1 BLOCK MISSING","2 BLOCKS MISSING","INCOMPLETE")) %>%
         left_join(.,AA_KEGG_modules,by="KEGG_Module"),aes(x=genome,y=module_name,fill=completeness)) + geom_tile() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) + facet_grid(AA_KEGG_modules_meta~Type,space="free",scales="free")  + scale_fill_manual(values=c("#fef0d9","#fdcc8a","#fc8d59","#d7301f"))

ggsave("outputs/kemet_AAs.pdf",height = 8,width = 18)
ggsave("outputs/kemet_AAs.png",height = 8,width = 18)
```

```{r}
# combine to plot
auxo_sat_one = data.frame(one$count,"single") %>% rename(count=one.count,combination=X.single.)

ggplot(auxo_sat,aes(x=combination,y=count,fill=combination)) + geom_boxplot()  + ylab("# resulting amino acid auxotrophies") + xlab("combinations")

#recreate plot in terms of % surviving coms
auxo_data = read.delim("data/figure_data/auxo_sat_data.tsv")
auxo_data %>% group_by(combination) %>% mutate(count_total=n()) %>% group_by(count,combination) %>% mutate(count_combo=n()) %>% unique() %>% mutate(percent=100*(count_combo/count_total)) %>% filter(count==0) %>% mutate(combo_num=ifelse(combination=="single",1,ifelse(combination=="pairwise",2,ifelse(combination=="triplet",3,4)))) -> auxo_df
  
ggplot(auxo_data %>% group_by(combination) %>% mutate(count_total=n()) %>% group_by(count,combination) %>% mutate(count_combo=n()) %>% unique() %>% mutate(percent=100*(count_combo/count_total)) %>% filter(count==0)) + geom_point(aes(x=combination,y=percent))

           Screen=gsub("lab","Experimental",Screen)), x="combo_num",y="percent",
  add="reg.line",conf.int = FALSE,color="Screen") + stat_cor(method="pearson",aes(color=Screen)) + 
  ylim(0,100) + ylab("Percent of communities with\nfully resolved AA auxotrophies (%)") +
```

```{r}
#media generations, basically create a file that has what amino acids should be removed from each sample due to the fact that it is experimentally determined to be prototrophic
#then use bash for loops to create a copy of the media file and then go through each amino acid and remove it from the media if it is not needed

experimental_auxo=read.delim("data/gem_curation/experimental_auxo.txt") %>% select(-Habitats,-X,-AAs_auxo,-Vitamin_auxo,-Nucleotide_auxo,-Sample_ID_MinPath,-Type,-Sites,-gapfilling.media,-remove,-keep) %>% filter(Sample_ID!="") %>% pivot_longer(!Sample_ID,names_to = "aa",values_to = "auxo") %>% mutate(auxo=replace_na(auxo,0)) %>% left_join(.,read.delim("data/gem_curation/amino_acids_bigg.tsv")) %>% filter(auxo!=1)
 write_delim(experimental_auxo,"data/media/media_generator.tsv")
# in bash
```
